newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Allied Ind mulls stake in consumer firm.
newsitem.headline: Allied Ind mulls stake in consumer firm.

text.p: Allied Industries International Ltd said on Monday it was in talks to buy a stake in a consumer products firm but added no agreement had yet been reached.

"The company is currently in discussion with an independent third party in connection with a proposed acquisition by the company of a minority stake in a consumer product company, which acquistion may constitute a notifiable transaction," the company said in a statement.
"Negotiations on the proposed transaction are at a preliminary stage and no agreement has been reached between the parties," it said.
The property and building materials concern said a board meeting would be held on Monday to consider the final results on the company for the year ended December 31, 1996.
